en.headline: Police arrest 15 over insurance licence exam cheating scheme
en.dek: Commercial Crime Bureau officers detained six men and nine women during a test at a Kwun Tong centre; the Insurance Authority has suspended recognition of the FLMI qualification.
body: Police have arrested 15 people in connection with an alleged scheme in which licensed insurance agents helped candidates cheat to obtain professional qualifications.

The Commercial Crime Bureau opened an investigation in January after a referral from the Insurance Authority. The regulator had received complaints last October that an education institution was helping examinees cheat on tests for the Fellow, Life Management Institute designation, a globally recognised industry credential.

In a raid on Thursday, officers moved in during a test at a Kwun Tong examination centre and arrested six men and nine women aged 22 to 70 on suspicion of conspiracy to defraud. Police believe 11 of the suspects formed the core of the syndicate; three are current insurance agents and three are former practitioners, while the remaining four are exam candidates.

Inspector Wong King-sai said the syndicate offered one-stop services covering registration, preparation courses and cheating for an extra HK$14,000 on top of the official exam fee. On test day, syndicate staff acted as invigilators and pre-installed remote-control software on candidates' computers so that another machine answered the questions. Candidates were told to stay in their seats and pretend to continue working before submitting answers after a plausible interval.

Maria Tsui, Head of Enforcement at the Insurance Authority, said the regulator would immediately suspend recognition of the FLMI qualification and review individuals who previously earned the credential through the implicated centre. About 250 people have obtained insurance licences using the FLMI designation since 2024, out of more than 120,000 licensed insurance agents citywide.

zh.headline: 保險牌照考試作弊案拘15人 監管局暫停承認相關資歷
zh.dek: 商業罪案調查科在觀塘試場突擊行動拘捕六男九女，保險業監管局即時暫停承認FLMI資歷。
body: 警方拘捕15人，涉嫌參與協助考生在保險專業資格考試中作弊的計劃。
商業罪案調查科在保險業監管局轉介後，於1月展開調查。監管局去年10月接獲投訴，指有教育機構協助考生在全球認可的壽險管理師（FLMI）考試中作弊。
周四在觀塘一個試場舉行考試期間，人員突擊行動，拘捕六男九女，年齡介乎22至70歲，涉嫌串謀詐騙。警方相信當中11人為集團核心成員，包括三名現職保險中介人及三名前從業員，其餘四人為考生。
督察黃景世表示，集團提供一條龍服務，涵蓋報名、備試課程至作弊安排，考生除官方考試費外須額外支付14,000元。考試當日，集團人員充當監考員，預先在考生電腦安裝遙控軟件，由幕後電腦代答試題，並指示考生留在座位假裝繼續作答，待一段合理時間後才提交。
保險業監管局執法部主管崔婉雯表示，監管局即時暫停承認FLMI資歷，並會覆核經涉事試場取得該資歷的人士。自2024年以來，約250人透過FLMI資歷取得保險牌照，全港持牌保險中介人超過12萬人。
